crossRefs.note: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.
These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for…
because all those men who have seen my glory, and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have…
You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

translations.web: When the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”
translations.bsb: At that time the Jews who lived nearby came and told us ten times over, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return
translations.asv: And it came to pass that, when the Jews that dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times from all places, Ye must return unto us.
